contract.effective_date_source: Seller's signature on the agreement, 09/24/2026 11:45 AM (Para. 11 and signature page)

deadlines.label: Earnest Money Due
deadlines.action: Deliver the $5,000 earnest money to Olentangy Crossing Title Agency
deadlines.if_missed: Seller may terminate the agreement by written notice to Buyer

deadlines.label: Loan Application Due
deadlines.if_missed: The agreement states no specific remedy

deadlines.label: Inspection Period Ends
deadlines.action: Deliver written notice terminating the agreement or requesting repairs
deadlines.if_missed: Buyer accepts the property in its present condition

deadlines.label: Appraisal Contingency Ends
deadlines.action: If the property appraises below the purchase price, deliver written notice to terminate (earnest money returned)
deadlines.if_missed: Right to terminate for a low appraisal ends

deadlines.label: Loan Commitment Deadline
deadlines.action: Deliver the written loan commitment to Seller, or deliver written notice to terminate before the period ends (earnest money returned)
deadlines.if_missed: The financing contingency no longer applies

deadlines.label: Final Walk-Through
deadlines.action: Walk through the property to confirm its condition
deadlines.if_missed: The agreement states no specific remedy

deadlines.label: Title Commitment Delivered
deadlines.action: Olentangy Crossing Title Agency provides the title commitment to Buyer
deadlines.if_missed: The agreement states no specific remedy
